verses.sanskrit:
दुर्योधन उवाच।
              कथं शिखण्डी गाङ्गेय कन्या भूत्त्वा पुरा तदा। पुरुषोऽभूद्युधि श्रेष्ठ तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह  ॥१॥
verses.english: Duryodhana said Tell me, O grandsire, how Shikhandin, who had been before a daughter, O son of Ganga, became a man. O foremost of warriors.

verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              भार्या तु तस्य राजेन्द्र द्रुपदस्य महीपतेः। महिषी दयिता ह्यासीदपुत्रा च विशांपते ॥२॥
verses.english: Bhishma said The chosen and beloved queen of king Drupada, O great king, was childless at first, O monarch.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु द्रुपदो वै महीपतिः। अपत्यार्थे महाराज तोषयामास शङ्करम् ॥३॥
verses.english: And during this time the highly intelligent king Drupada, pleased by worship, O mighty king, the God Shankara for the sake of offspring.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मद्वधार्थं निश्चित्य तपो घोरं समास्थितः। ऋते कन्यां महादेव पुत्रो मे स्यादिति ब्रुवन् ॥४॥
verses.english: Resolving to bring about my destruction, he took to the severest penances, and said “Let mine be a son, and not a daughter, 0 Mahadeva;

verses.sanskrit: भगवन् पुत्रमिच्छामि भीष्मं प्रतिचिकीर्षया। इत्युक्तो देवदेवेन स्त्रीपुमांस्ते भविष्यति ॥५॥
verses.english: O God, I desire a son, to revenge myself on Bhishma.” Then this was said (to him) by Mahadeva, "Your son shall be both male and female.

verses.sanskrit: निवर्तस्व महीपाल नैतज्जात्वन्यथा भवेत्। स तु गत्वा च नगरं भार्यामिदमुवाच ह ॥६॥
verses.english: Desist therefore, O protector of the earth, it shall never be otherwise." He (king Drupada) entering his city said to his wife.
verses.bhavadeepa: स्त्रीपुमान् पूर्वं स्त्री सैव श्चात् पुमान् । पूर्वकालैकसर्वेति समासः ॥५॥

verses.sanskrit: कृतो यत्नो महादेवस्तपसाऽऽराधितो मया। कन्या भूत्वा पुमान्भावी इति चोक्तोऽस्मि शम्भुना ॥७॥
verses.english: "I have made a great exertion; O goddess, I have worshipped Shambhu by penances, and I have been told by him. “Your offspring) will first be a female and will then become a man."

verses.sanskrit: पुनः पुनर्याच्यमानो दिष्टमित्यब्रवीच्छिवः। न तदन्यच्च भविता भवितव्यं हि तत्तथा ॥८॥
verses.english: Though repeatedly solicited, Shiva only said “It is decreed by destiny. It shall not be otherwise, but when as I have told you”.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सा नियता भूत्वा ऋतुकाले मनस्विनी। पत्नी द्रुपद्राजस्य द्रुपदं प्रविवेश ह ॥९॥
verses.english: Thereupon that lady of great force of mind kept her mind rigidly pure and the wife of king Drupada, at the proper time went to king Drupada.

verses.sanskrit: लेभे गर्भं यथाकालं विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा। पार्षतस्य महीपाल यथा मां नारदोऽब्रवीत् ॥१०॥
verses.english: Agreeably to the decrees of destiny the wife of Prishata, in due time, conceived, as Narada informed me, O ruler of the Earth.
verses.bhavadeepa: द्रुपदं प्रविवेश ह तेन सह मिथुनीभावं जगाम ॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: ततो दधार सा देवी गर्भं राजीवलोचना। तां स राजा प्रियां भार्यां द्रुपदः कुरुनन्दन ॥११॥
verses.english: And that goddess, whose eyes resembled the petals on the lotus, continued to hold her fetus. And to that dear wife, O son of Kuru, king Drupada,
verses.bhavadeepa: विधिदृष्टेन शास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा गर्भाधानाख्येन । पार्षतस्य गर्भं दधार इति उत्तरेण सम्बन्धः ॥१०॥

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रस्नेहान्महाबाहुः सुखं पर्यचरत्तदा। सर्वानभिप्रायकृतान् भार्याऽलभत कौरव ॥१२॥
verses.english: The mighty-armed one, on account of his affection for his son, ordered all that was agreeable. And O Kaurava, his wife obtained everything that she desired.

verses.sanskrit: अपुत्रस्य सतो राज्ञो द्रुपदस्य महीपतेः। यथाकालं तु सा देवी महिषी द्रुपदस्य ह ॥१३॥
verses.english: And in due time that goddess, the queen of the childless lord of earth, king Drupada,

verses.sanskrit: कन्यां प्रवररूपां तु प्राजायत नराधिप। अपुत्रस्य तु राज्ञः सा द्रुपदस्य मनस्विनी ॥१४॥
verses.english: Even that lady of great force of mind, O lord of men, gave birth to a daughter of great beauty.

verses.sanskrit: ख्यापयामास राजेन्द्र पुत्रो ह्येष ममेति वै। ततः स राजा द्रुपदः प्रच्छन्नाया नराधिप ॥१५॥
verses.english: O great king, thereupon the king Drupada gave out to all, this is my son, and for this daughter, who was concealed.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रवत् पुत्रकार्याणि सर्वाणि समकारयत्। रक्षणं चैव मन्त्रस्य महिषी द्रुपदस्य सा ॥१६॥
verses.english: O lord of men, (he) caused all the necessary rites to be performed just as if it were a son. And the imperial wife of Drupada protected the secret with all due care, saying, "This is a son indeed.” And neither did any one else other than the son of Prishata know (the child to be a) daughter, in all that city.

verses.sanskrit: चकार सर्वयत्नेन ब्रुवाणा पुत्र इत्युत। न च तां वेद नगरे कश्चिदन्यत्र पार्षतात् ॥१७॥
श्रद्दधानो हि तद्वाक्यं देवस्याच्युततेजसः। छादयामास तां कन्यां पुमानिति च सोऽब्रवीत् ॥१८॥
verses.english: Reverencing the words of that god of immeasurable glory, he kept to himself that she was a daughter, and said, “This is a male child."

verses.sanskrit: जातकर्माणि सर्वाणि कारयामास पार्थिवः। पुंवद्विधानयुक्तानि शिखण्डीति च तां विदुः ॥१९॥
verses.english: And that king caused all the rites prescribed for a son during infancy to be performed according to all due ordinances, and named her Shikhandin.

verses.sanskrit: अहमेकस्तु चारेण वचनान्नारदस्य च। ज्ञातवान् देववाक्येन अम्बायास्तपसा तथा ॥२०॥
verses.english: I alone, by means of spies, and through the words of Narada, and through the words of the god (Shiva) and also from the austerities of Amba, was informed (of the child being a son).
